scripts.build:android: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:ios:ipa: npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -archivePath build/AstroStar.xcarchive archive CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.build:macos: npm run tauri:build && rm -rf /tmp/dmg_build && mkdir -p /tmp/dmg_build && cp -r src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/AstroStar.app /tmp/dmg_build/ && cp src-tauri/README.txt /tmp/dmg_build/ && hdiutil create -volname AstroStar -srcfolder /tmp/dmg_build -ov -format UDZO AstroStar.dmg
